descriptionHtml:
Cooler Master MasterFrame 600 Mesh High Airflow Mid Tower Case (Includes GPU Support Bracket / ARGB PWM Controller Hub / Pre-Installed 2x 200mm & 1x 120mm ARGB Fans / Up to 420mm Radiator Support / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Build your dream high-performance desktop with absolute cooling efficiency using the Cooler Master MasterFrame 600 Mesh Mid Tower Gaming Case, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Crafted with SGCC Steel, Aluminum, and Tempered Glass, this 73.6L chassis features pre-installed dual SickleFlow 200 ARGB front fans and a rear SickleFlow 120 ARGB fan. Engineered to support massive water cooling radiators up to 420mm on top, front, and side, it accommodates high-end motherboard formats up to E-ATX and SSI-CEB, alongside 8 PCIe expansion slots, high-speed USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C, an ARGB PWM Hub, and a heavy-duty GPU support bracket.
